text:
First-Year Value = After-tax cash + Retirement match + Vested equity

Formulas used:
After-tax cash = (salary + salary * bonus%) * (1 - 0.35)
Retirement match = min(salary * match% , cap)
Vested equity by end month 12 = grant * 12 / (4 * 12) = grant * 12 / 48

North calculation from original inputs:
After-tax cash_N = (140000.00 + 140000.00 * 0) * (1 - 0.35)
= 140000.00 * 0.65 = 91000.00
Retirement_N = min(140000.00 * 0.05 , 9000.00)
= min(7000.00 , 9000.00) = 7000.00
Vested equity_N = 160000.00 * 12 / 48
= 160000.00 * 0.25 = 40000.00
Total_N = 91000.00 + 7000.00 + 40000.00 = 138000.00

South calculation from original inputs:
After-tax cash_S = (185000.00 + 185000.00 * 0.10) * (1 - 0.35)
= (185000.00 + 18500.00) * 0.65
= 203500.00 * 0.65 = 132275.00
Retirement_S = min(185000.00 * 0.06 , 6000.00)
= min(11100.00 , 6000.00) = 6000.00
Vested equity_S = 0.00 * 12 / 48 = 0.00
Total_S = 132275.00 + 6000.00 + 0.00 = 138275.00

Recomputed totals independently:
North = (140000.00)*(0.65) + 7000.00 + 40000.00 = 138000.00
South = (203500.00)*(0.65) + 6000.00 + 0.00 = 138275.00

South 138275.00 > North 138000.00, so South has higher first-year value.
